title: Minecraft Remake
script:
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
   Name = "Minecraft Remake (FE)",
   LoadingTitle = "Loading...", 
   LoadingStatus = "Made by test_febypass", -- Cambiado a tu nombre
   KeySystem = false
})

local Tab = Window:CreateTab("Constructor Visual", 4483345998)
local Player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

-- Función para teletransportar una pieza existente
local function MovePartToMouse()
    local Mouse = Player:GetMouse()
    if Mouse.Hit then
        -- Buscamos una pieza llamada "Part"
        local part = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Part")
        
        if part then
            part.Position = Mouse.Hit.p + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
            part.Anchored = true
            part.CanCollide = true
            Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Éxito", Content = "Bloque teletransportado y visible.", Duration = 2})
        else
            Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Error", Content = "No se encontró ninguna pieza llamada 'Part'.", Duration = 3})
        end
    end
end

Tab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Mover Bloque (Visual para todos)",
   Callback = function()
        MovePartToMouse()
   end,
})

Tab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Resetear Posición de Part",
   Callback = function()
        local part = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Part")
        if part then
            part.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Reset", Content = "Bloque devuelto.", Duration = 2})
        end
   end,
})
features: With this script you'll be able to build like Minecraft, and soon it will be visual.
